liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mountains of the Moon** (1 review): The reviewer describes the performance of this song as fantastic [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-02-22.sbd.vernon.5206.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 110 min; rated 4.22/5 by 9 [1]
- **gd1969-02-22.sbd.miller.112691.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 114 min; rated 4.62/5 by 24 [2]. Said about its sound: The new remaster is crystal clear, unlike the muddy previous transfers; The reviewer finds this specific version of the song crisp and clean; The jam transitioning into Dark Star is described as haunting and resonant [9][10][11][12]

## Around the show

- Jerry began the song playing acoustic guitar in the wild Vallejo atmosphere [3]
- Jerry announced the intermission as a chance for the crowd to rest [4]
- The performance is considered slightly inferior to the Live/Dead version of Dark Star [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-02-22.sbd.vernon.5206.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: SBD > MR > R > R > DAT > CDR [1]. Also: Paul B. kindly provided the seed disks for this specific recording transfer [1]
- **gd1969-02-22.sbd.miller.112691.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: David Gans and Dick Latvala provided the DAT source for the tape [2]
